record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare FAKE_OUT: Purrloin (1 star) and Liepard (2 stars); both have maxPP 90, range 1 and no passive (catalog NONE). The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).

dispatch.note: Routing is a direct registry entry with a dedicated file; no routing uncertainty was queued for this record.

record.summary: Single target, in this order: (1) the check caster AP >= 0 (AP 0 qualifies), then triggerFlinch(3000, target) - the TARGET supplies the duration reductions and Rune Protect refuses it; (2) SPECIAL damage 40 / 80 / 150 / 300 (AP and crit scale it); (3) the caster's own addAbilityPower(-30, self, apBoost 0, crit false). The self loss is a REQUEST through own-team helpers (a Big Eater Belt amplifies it: -30 becomes -38; a Twist Band does not reverse a self loss; floor -100), runs even when the damage was blocked, and lowers AP so later casts may fail the threshold (executed: -30 then -60 with one flinch call). A Nullify Bandanna conversion is a direct-call helper path (canCast normally prevents such a cast).

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

declaredRaw.condition: pokemon.ap >= 0 (caster AP at cast time, before the -30)

effects.scaling: Requested duration 3000 ms, not AP-scaled. Applied duration = 3000 after Swift Swim x0.7 / Hydration x0.5 / Water Veil or Surge Surfer x0.3 (first matching only), then Odd Keystone x(1-0.1 x stones) with rounding; it only replaces flinchCooldown if longer than the remaining one. Not applied when the target has Rune Protect. Because it is applied before handleSpecialDamage, it is not stopped by protect / skydiving / magicBounce.
effects.resolution: Combat effect of flinch read here: shield absorbs only half of each hit (pokemon-state handleDamage). Any other consumer of status.flinch was not searched exhaustively.

effects.scaling: requested = table value by caster stars. AP: x(1 + AP/100) using the caster's AP at call time (before this cast's -30 AP); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false).
effects.resolution: Requested = raw table value; applied = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, minimum 1) in handleDamage; shields are resolved in handleDamage and the returned takenDamage is unused (section J1). A flinched target's shield takes only half of the hit (the flinch was applied just before). Blocked completely if the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce.

effects.scaling: addAbilityPower(-30, self, apBoost 0, crit false): value = round(-30 x (1 + 0)) = -30. Big Eater Belt on the caster: negative change from the same team is multiplied by 1.25 and floored (-30 -> -37.5 -> -38; roundToNDigits 'down' is Math.floor). Twist Band does not flip it (caster is on the caster's own team). Nullify Bandana on the caster: no AP change; instead attack changes by round(0.2 x -30) = -6 (itself subject to addAttack's helpers).
effects.resolution: Applied: AP = max(-100, AP - 30) (belt: -38). Not permanent (permanent flag false), so the board Pokémon's stored AP is unchanged. Evaluated after the damage hit, so it never reduces this cast's damage but does lower the AP seen by the next cast's flinch check (a caster at AP < 0 skips the flinch).

effects.scaling: addAbilityPower(-30, self, 0, false): Nullify Bandanna is checked first (direct-call path only: canCast blocks such a cast); otherwise Math.round(-30), then the recipient's helpers: a Big Eater Belt amplifies a negative value from the own team (-30 -> -38, rounded down toward -infinity), a Twist Band does NOT reverse a self loss, then ap = min(-100)(ap + value)
effects.resolution: made after the damage call whatever its result (a protected target still costs 30 AP); AP below 0 skips the flinch of later casts but not their damage or the loss (executed: AP 0 -> -30 -> -60). A Nullify holder's direct call routes addAttack(round(0.2 x -30) = -6), -8 with a Belt.

statusEffects.scaling: fixed 3000 ms, not AP-scaled; stored = round(3000 x the TARGET's duration reductions)
statusEffects.guards: only attempted when the caster's AP >= 0 at cast time (checked before the call); refused by the target's Rune Protect; reductions read the target (executed: target HYDRATION 1500, caster HYDRATION 3000); a longer remaining flinch is kept
statusEffects.combatEffect: while flinched and shielded the target's shield takes the flinch split (see the shared handleDamage flinch branch); other consumers of status.flinch were not searched

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star and 4-star entries (150 / 300, fallback 300) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes. Flinch duration and AP loss do not depend on stars. maxPP 90 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target (requiresTarget true). The only condition is the caster's AP sign for the flinch.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast permanently-for-the-fight lowers AP by 30 (floor -100); once AP is negative the flinch is skipped on later casts while damage still happens (damage is then reduced by the negative AP: x(1 + AP/100)).
record.rawVsResolved: Raw: damage 40/80, flinch 3000 ms, AP -30. Requested = raw; applied damage = requested x (1 + casterAP/100) [x crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1). Applied flinch = 3000 after duration reductions, or none (Rune Protect / AP < 0). Applied AP change = -30 (-38 with Big Eater Belt; Nullify Bandana converts it to -6 attack). The returned takenDamage is unused (section J1).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1, the shield-half-on-flinch step and the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Other consumers of status.flinch beyond pokemon-state.ts shield handling (searched pokemon-state, pokemon-entity, attacking-state, moving-state by name)
unresolved: How the target is chosen before the cast was not read.
Whether other code paths consume status.flinch (e.g. attack or cast prevention) was not exhaustively searched; only the shield-halving in handleDamage was confirmed.

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (triggerFlinch, applyStatusDurationReductions, handleSpecialDamage, addAbilityPower, canCast) and the real FakeOutStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_C2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in units): the AP >= 0 gate, the flinch with target-supplied reductions and Rune Protect, the damage values, the self AP request with Belt / Twist / floor, the blocked-hit case, the second cast and the Nullify helper path with the castAbility refusal.
